title: भीमफेदीमा इभी दुर्घटना : ठाडो भीरबाट माथि शव ल्याउनै सकस, कम्तीमा ४ घण्टा लाग्ने
content:
हेटौँडा । पछिल्लो समय बारा, पर्सा, रौतहट, सर्लाहीसम्मका जनताका लागि उत्तम बनेको छ हेटौँडा–भीमफेदी हुँदै सिस्नेरी र फाखेल सडक । पूर्वी चितवनको पनि पर्सा बजारसम्मका मानिस यही बाटो हुँदै काठमाडौँ आउँछन् । मकवानपुरलाई त पायक पर्ने नै भयो, भारतीय सहरका मानिस पनि यही बाटो हिँडछ्न । मुग्लिन मलेखु सडक अवरुद्ध हुँदा पनि काठमाडौँ छिर्ने नाकाका रुपमा यो बाटो चालु रहन पर्छ भनेर बागमती प्रदेश सरकारले गौरवको आयोजनामा राखेको वैकल्पिक मार्ग पछिल्लो पटक ज्यानमारा सडकका रुपमा परिचय बनाइरहेको छ । साना सवारी साधनको दुर्घटना बढ्दा धेरै नागरिकले ज्यान गुमाइरहेका छन् । अदालतका न्यायाधीश, रजिस्ट्रारको परिवारसम्म दुर्घटनामा परेका छन् । सर्वसाधारणको उस्तै काल बनिरहेको छ । छोटो मार्ग भए पनि दुर्घटना बढेपछि प्रहरीका उच्च अधिकृत, सेना र सशस्त्रसमेत दुर्घटनापछि उद्धारमा ठूलो संख्यामा खटिनु पर्ने अवस्था बनेको छ । बिहीबार बिहान भीमफेदी–६ चिसापानी गढीस्थित भीमफेदी कुलेखानी काठमाडौँ सडकखण्डमा इभी दुर्घटनामा १० जनाको मृत्यु भयो । पहिलो चरणमा ३ जना, पछि २ जना र थप एक बालिकासहित ६ जनाको उद्धार हुँदा १० बज्नै लागिसकेको थियो । अर्थात् सडकबाट गाडी ५ सय मिटर तल झरेको र अझ ठाडो भिर परेकाले कठिनाइ भएको भीमफेदी इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रहरी नायव निरीक्षक दीपेन्द्र ढकाल बताउँछन् । उनी भन्छन्, ‘घाइतेलाई माथि सडकमा ल्याएर अस्पताल पठाउने काम पहिलो हो तर सडकसम्म घाइते ल्याउनै कठिन भयो, कम्तीमा ४५ देखि एकघण्टासम्म लाग्न सक्छ ।’ ‘घटनास्थलमा १० वटा शव छन् । ती शवहरु ल्याउन डेढ घण्टासम्म लाग्छ होला,’ ढकालले भने, ‘माथि हेर्दा चौरजस्तो ठाउँबाट गाडी खसेको छ तर तल ठाडो भीर छ, तल पुग्न र माथि फर्कन उस्तै चुनौती छ ।’ ‘एकदम ठाडो भीरबाट शव ल्याउन सक्ने अवस्था देखिएन,’ घटनास्थलमा रहेका मकवानपुरका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक श्याम खत्री भन्छन्, ‘तल शव बाँधेर माथिबाट तान्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छौँ, अरु ४ घण्टा जति लाग्न सक्छ कि ?’ उनले एउटा–एउटा शव बोकेर माथि ल्याउन सकिने अवस्था नै नभएको बताए । उद्धारमा ४८ सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन यो सडकमा महिनैपिच्छे भइरहने यस्ता दुर्घटनाले ठूलो संख्यामा सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन हुनु परेको छ । बिहीबारको दुर्घटनाको खबरपछि पनि सेना, सशस्त्र र प्रहरीको ४८ जनाको टोली परिचालन भयो । मकवानपुरका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक आफैँ १० जनाको टोली लिएर बिहानै पुगे । पहिला नै भीमफेदी इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयबा प्रहरी नायव निरीक्षक दीपेन्द्र ढकालको ७ जनाको टोली गइसकेको थियो । भीमफेदी कारागार सुरक्षामा रहेको सशस्त्र ।प्रहरी बल नेपाल कारगार सरक्षा बेसका सशस्त्रका डिएसपी देबेन्द्र सिंहको कमाण्डमा थप १० जना घटनास्थल पुगे । भीमफेदीमै रहेको बहुउद्देश्यीय प्लाष्टिक उद्योगका सेनानि आरोग्य गौतमको कमाण्डमा ११ जना सेना खटिए । बागमती प्रदेश विपद् व्यवस्थापन गुल्मबाट प्रहरी सहायक निरीक्षक जय प्रकाश यादव पनि १० जनाको टोलीसहित घटनास्थल पुगे । एउटा दुर्घटनामा ३ सुरक्षा निकायका ४८ जना सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन भएका थिए् । चालक भेटिएनन काठमाडौँबाट सर्लाही आइरहेको म.प्र.०३–००१ ज ०८८० नम्बरको यात्रु बाहक इभी हाइस सडकबाट अन्दाजी ५ सय मिटर तल भिरमा खस्यो । १० जनाको घटनास्थलमै मृत्यु भयो । ५ पुरुष, ३ महिला र २ बालबालिका मृत भेटिएका छन् । ‘चालक अहिलेसम्म जीवित छन् कि यिनै मृतमध्ये हुन् खुलेको छैन,’ प्रहरी उपरीक्षक श्याम खत्रीले भने, ‘गाडी काउन्टरबाट आएजस्तो पनि देखिन्न, रिजर्भको हो जस्तो देखिन्छ, चालक खोज्दैछौँ ।’ गाडीमा यात्रुको चलान पुर्जी नभएकाले मृतकहरुको उद्धारमा त समय लाग्नै नै भयो, हत्पत्ति पहिचान खुल्न पनि कठिन छ । ‘सर्लाहीको चक्रघट्टाबाट केही फोन आएको छ, बाँकी कोही सम्पर्कमा आएका छैनन्,’ एसपी खत्रीले भने, ‘अब शव हेटौँडा पुर्याएपछि परिचय खुलाउन लाग्नेछौँ, सम्पर्कमा आउलान् पनि !’ सुरक्षा सावधानी जरुरी भीमफेदी–कुलेखानी हुँदै काठमाडौँ आवतजावत गर्ने सुमो तथा विद्युतीय सवारीसाधन (इभी)मा यात्रु विवरण राख्ने तथा चलान व्यवस्थापन गर्ने कार्य प्रभावकारी नहुँदा यात्रु सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठेको छ । यो रुटमा सञ्चालन हुने कतिपय सवारीसाधनका चालकले यात्रुको नाम, सम्पर्क नम्बर, यात्रु सङ्ख्या, चढ्ने तथा ओर्लने स्थानसहितको विवरण उल्लेख गरिएको चलान तयार नगरेको पाइएको छ । कतिपय अवस्थामा यात्रुलाई टिकट नै नदिने र टिकट दिए पनि यात्रुको नाम तथा सम्पर्क नम्बर उल्लेख नगर्ने समस्या छ । सवारीसाधनमा कति जना यात्रु चढे, को कहाँसम्म जाने हो र कहाँ ओर्लने हो भन्ने विवरणसमेत व्यवस्थित रूपमा अभिलेख नराख्दा यात्रुको वास्तविक अवस्था पत्ता लगाउन कठिन हुने देखिन्छ। कुनै सवारीसाधन दुर्घटनामा पर्दा कति जना यात्रु सवार थिए, उनीहरू को–को थिए, उनीहरूको सम्पर्क नम्बर के थियो, कहाँबाट चढेका थिए र कहाँ ओर्लने योजना थियो ? यस्ता आधारभूत जानकारी तत्काल उपलब्ध नहुँदा उद्धार, घाइतेको पहिचान तथा परिवारका सदस्यलाई खबर गर्नसमेत कठिनाइ भइरहेको छ । Hetauda. Recently, the Hetauda-Bhimphedi-Sisneri and Pakhel road has become better for people from Bara, Parsa, Rautahat, and Sarlahi. People from eastern Chitwan to Parsa Bazaar also use this road to reach Kathmandu. Makawanpur has become a must-see, and people from Indian cities also travel this route. The Bagmati Province government has recently introduced the alternative route, which was put up as a pride project, as a deadly road, saying that even when the Muglin-Malekhu road is blocked, this road must remain operational as a gateway to Kathmandu. Many citizens are losing their lives due to the increase in small vehicle accidents. Even the families of court judges and registrars have been involved in accidents. The same fate is looming for the general public. Despite the short route, the increase in accidents has led to a situation where high-ranking police officers, the army, and even the armed forces have to be deployed in large numbers for rescue operations after accidents. On Thursday morning, 10 people died in an EV accident on the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani Kathmandu road section at Chisapani Gadhi in Bhimphedi-6. It was almost 10 o'clock when 3 people were rescued in the first phase, 2 later and 6 more, including a girl. That is, the vehicle fell 500 meters from the road and faced a steep cliff, which made it difficult, says Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal of the Bhimphedi Area Police Office. He says, 'The first task is to bring the injured up to the road and send them to the hospital, but it is difficult to bring the injured to the road, it may take at least 45 to an hour.' "There are 10 bodies at the scene. It will take about an hour and a half to retrieve them," Dhakal said. "Looking from above, the vehicle fell from a grassy area, but there is a steep cliff below. It is equally challenging to reach the bottom and return to the top." "It is not possible to bring the bodies down from the very steep cliff," said Makawanpur Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, who was at the scene. "We are trying to tie the bodies down and pull them up from the top. Will it take another four hours?" He said that it is not possible to bring the bodies up one by one. 48 security personnel mobilized for rescue Such accidents that have been happening on this road for months have necessitated the mobilization of a large number of security personnel. Even after the news of Thursday's accident, a 48-member team from the army, armed forces, and police was mobilized. The Makawanpur Superintendent of Police himself arrived in the morning with a team of 10. A 7-member team led by Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal had already left for Bhimphedi Area Police Office. Armed Police Force Nepal, which is guarding the Bhimphedi Prison, reached the scene of the incident under the command of DSP Devendra Singh, Armed Police Force of the Nepal Prison Security Base. 11 soldiers were deployed under the command of Arogya Gautam, a soldier from the Multi-Purpose Plastic Industry in Bhimphedi. Assistant Inspector of Police Jay Prakash Yadav from the Bagmati Province Disaster Management Group also reached the scene with a team of 10. 48 security personnel from 3 security agencies were mobilized in one accident. Driver not found. A passenger EV with registration number M.P.03-001 Ja 0880 coming from Kathmandu to Sarlahi fell off a cliff about 500 meters below the road. 10 people died on the spot. 5 men, 3 women and 2 children were found dead. 'It is not yet clear whether the driver is alive or among the dead,' said Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, 'The vehicle does not look like it came from the counter, it looks like it belongs to the reserve, we are looking for the driver.' Since there were no passenger documents in the vehicle, it took time to rescue the deceased, and it is also difficult to identify the deceased. 'We have received some calls from Chakraghatta in Sarlahi, but no one else has been contacted,' said SP Khatri. 'Now, after the bodies are taken to Hetauda, we will start identifying them, they will be contacted!' Safety precautions are essential The inefficiency in maintaining passenger details and managing invoices on Sumo and electric vehicles (EVs) travelling to Kathmandu via Bhimphedi-Kulekhani has raised serious questions about passenger safety. It has been found that some drivers of vehicles operating on this route have not prepared invoices that mention the passenger's name, contact number, number of passengers, and boarding and alighting locations. In some cases, there is a problem of not giving tickets to passengers, and even if tickets are given, the passenger's name and contact number are not mentioned. Without systematic records of how many passengers boarded the vehicle, who was going where, and where they were getting off, it seems difficult to find out the real status of the passengers. When a vehicle is involved in an accident, how many passengers were on board, who they were, what their contact numbers were, where they boarded and where they planned to get off? Without such basic information being immediately available, it is difficult to rescue, identify the injured, and even notify family members.

।प्रहरी बल नेपाल कारगार सरक्षा बेसका सशस्त्रका डिएसपी देबेन्द्र सिंहको कमाण्डमा थप १० जना घटनास्थल पुगे । भीमफेदीमै रहेको बहुउद्देश्यीय प्लाष्टिक उद्योगका सेनानि आरोग्य गौतमको कमाण्डमा ११ जना सेना खटिए । बागमती प्रदेश विपद् व्यवस्थापन गुल्मबाट प्रहरी सहायक निरीक्षक जय प्रकाश यादव पनि १० जनाको टोलीसहित घटनास्थल पुगे । एउटा दुर्घटनामा ३ सुरक्षा निकायका ४८ जना सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन भएका थिए् । चालक भेटिएनन काठमाडौँबाट सर्लाही आइरहेको म.प्र.०३–००१ ज ०८८० नम्बरको यात्रु बाहक इभी हाइस सडकबाट अन्दाजी ५ सय मिटर तल भिरमा खस्यो । १० जनाको घटनास्थलमै मृत्यु भयो । ५ पुरुष, ३ महिला र २ बालबालिका मृत भेटिएका छन् । ‘चालक अहिलेसम्म जीवित छन् कि यिनै मृतमध्ये हुन् खुलेको छैन,’ प्रहरी उपरीक्षक श्याम खत्रीले भने, ‘गाडी काउन्टरबाट आएजस्तो पनि देखिन्न, रिजर्भको हो जस्तो देखिन्छ, चालक खोज्दैछौँ ।’ गाडीमा यात्रुको चलान पुर्जी नभएकाले मृतकहरुको उद्धारमा त समय लाग्नै नै भयो, हत्पत्ति पहिचान खुल्न पनि कठिन छ । ‘सर्लाहीको चक्रघट्टाबाट केही फोन आएको छ, बाँकी कोही सम्पर्कमा आएका छैनन्,’ एसपी खत्रीले भने, ‘अब शव हेटौँडा पुर्याएपछि परिचय खुलाउन लाग्नेछौँ, सम्पर्कमा आउलान् पनि !’ सुरक्षा सावधानी जरुरी भीमफेदी–कुलेखानी हुँदै काठमाडौँ आवतजावत गर्ने सुमो तथा विद्युतीय सवारीसाधन (इभी)मा यात्रु विवरण राख्ने तथा चलान व्यवस्थापन गर्ने कार्य प्रभावकारी नहुँदा यात्रु सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठेको छ । यो रुटमा सञ्चालन हुने कतिपय सवारीसाधनका चालकले यात्रुको नाम, सम्पर्क नम्बर, यात्रु सङ्ख्या, चढ्ने तथा ओर्लने स्थानसहितको विवरण उल्लेख गरिएको चलान तयार नगरेको पाइएको छ । कतिपय अवस्थामा यात्रुलाई टिकट नै नदिने र टिकट दिए पनि यात्रुको नाम तथा सम्पर्क नम्बर उल्लेख नगर्ने समस्या छ । सवारीसाधनमा कति जना यात्रु चढे, को कहाँसम्म जाने हो र कहाँ ओर्लने हो भन्ने विवरणसमेत व्यवस्थित रूपमा अभिलेख नराख्दा यात्रुको वास्तविक अवस्था पत्ता लगाउन कठिन हुने देखिन्छ। कुनै सवारीसाधन दुर्घटनामा पर्दा कति जना यात्रु सवार थिए, उनीहरू को–को थिए, उनीहरूको सम्पर्क नम्बर के थियो, कहाँबाट चढेका थिए र कहाँ ओर्लने योजना थियो ? यस्ता आधारभूत जानकारी तत्काल उपलब्ध नहुँदा उद्धार, घाइतेको पहिचान तथा परिवारका सदस्यलाई खबर गर्नसमेत कठिनाइ भइरहेको छ ।

हेटौँडा । पछिल्लो समय बारा, पर्सा, रौतहट, सर्लाहीसम्मका जनताका लागि उत्तम बनेको छ हेटौँडा–भीमफेदी हुँदै सिस्नेरी र फाखेल सडक । पूर्वी चितवनको पनि पर्सा बजारसम्मका मानिस यही बाटो हुँदै काठमाडौँ आउँछन् ।

मकवानपुरलाई त पायक पर्ने नै भयो, भारतीय सहरका मानिस पनि यही बाटो हिँडछ्न । मुग्लिन मलेखु सडक अवरुद्ध हुँदा पनि काठमाडौँ छिर्ने नाकाका रुपमा यो बाटो चालु रहन पर्छ भनेर बागमती प्रदेश सरकारले गौरवको आयोजनामा राखेको वैकल्पिक मार्ग पछिल्लो पटक ज्यानमारा सडकका रुपमा परिचय बनाइरहेको छ ।

साना सवारी साधनको दुर्घटना बढ्दा धेरै नागरिकले ज्यान गुमाइरहेका छन् । अदालतका न्यायाधीश, रजिस्ट्रारको परिवारसम्म दुर्घटनामा परेका छन् । सर्वसाधारणको उस्तै काल बनिरहेको छ ।

छोटो मार्ग भए पनि दुर्घटना बढेपछि प्रहरीका उच्च अधिकृत, सेना र सशस्त्रसमेत दुर्घटनापछि उद्धारमा ठूलो संख्यामा खटिनु पर्ने अवस्था बनेको छ ।

बिहीबार बिहान भीमफेदी–६ चिसापानी गढीस्थित भीमफेदी कुलेखानी काठमाडौँ सडकखण्डमा इभी दुर्घटनामा १० जनाको मृत्यु भयो । पहिलो चरणमा ३ जना, पछि २ जना र थप एक बालिकासहित ६ जनाको उद्धार हुँदा १० बज्नै लागिसकेको थियो । अर्थात् सडकबाट गाडी ५ सय मिटर तल झरेको र अझ ठाडो भिर परेकाले कठिनाइ भएको भीमफेदी इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रहरी नायव निरीक्षक दीपेन्द्र ढकाल बताउँछन् । उनी भन्छन्, ‘घाइतेलाई माथि सडकमा ल्याएर अस्पताल पठाउने काम पहिलो हो तर सडकसम्म घाइते ल्याउनै कठिन भयो, कम्तीमा ४५ देखि एकघण्टासम्म लाग्न सक्छ ।’

‘घटनास्थलमा १० वटा शव छन् । ती शवहरु ल्याउन डेढ घण्टासम्म लाग्छ होला,’ ढकालले भने, ‘माथि हेर्दा चौरजस्तो ठाउँबाट गाडी खसेको छ तर तल ठाडो भीर छ, तल पुग्न र माथि फर्कन उस्तै चुनौती छ ।’

‘एकदम ठाडो भीरबाट शव ल्याउन सक्ने अवस्था देखिएन,’ घटनास्थलमा रहेका मकवानपुरका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक श्याम खत्री भन्छन्, ‘तल शव बाँधेर माथिबाट तान्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छौँ, अरु ४ घण्टा जति लाग्न सक्छ कि ?’ उनले एउटा–एउटा शव बोकेर माथि ल्याउन सकिने अवस्था नै नभएको बताए ।

उद्धारमा ४८ सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन

यो सडकमा महिनैपिच्छे भइरहने यस्ता दुर्घटनाले ठूलो संख्यामा सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन हुनु परेको छ । बिहीबारको दुर्घटनाको खबरपछि पनि सेना, सशस्त्र र प्रहरीको ४८ जनाको टोली परिचालन भयो । मकवानपुरका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक आफैँ १० जनाको टोली लिएर बिहानै पुगे । पहिला नै भीमफेदी इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयबा प्रहरी नायव निरीक्षक दीपेन्द्र ढकालको ७ जनाको टोली गइसकेको थियो ।

भीमफेदी कारागार सुरक्षामा रहेको सशस्त्र ।प्रहरी बल नेपाल कारगार सरक्षा बेसका सशस्त्रका डिएसपी देबेन्द्र सिंहको कमाण्डमा थप १० जना घटनास्थल पुगे । भीमफेदीमै रहेको बहुउद्देश्यीय प्लाष्टिक उद्योगका सेनानि आरोग्य गौतमको कमाण्डमा ११ जना सेना खटिए । बागमती प्रदेश विपद् व्यवस्थापन गुल्मबाट प्रहरी सहायक निरीक्षक जय प्रकाश यादव पनि १० जनाको टोलीसहित घटनास्थल पुगे । एउटा दुर्घटनामा ३ सुरक्षा निकायका ४८ जना सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन भएका थिए् ।

चालक भेटिएनन

काठमाडौँबाट सर्लाही आइरहेको म.प्र.०३–००१ ज ०८८० नम्बरको यात्रु बाहक इभी हाइस सडकबाट अन्दाजी ५ सय मिटर तल भिरमा खस्यो । १० जनाको घटनास्थलमै मृत्यु भयो । ५ पुरुष, ३ महिला र २ बालबालिका मृत भेटिएका छन् । ‘चालक अहिलेसम्म जीवित छन् कि यिनै मृतमध्ये हुन् खुलेको छैन,’ प्रहरी उपरीक्षक श्याम खत्रीले भने, ‘गाडी काउन्टरबाट आएजस्तो पनि देखिन्न, रिजर्भको हो जस्तो देखिन्छ, चालक खोज्दैछौँ ।’

गाडीमा यात्रुको चलान पुर्जी नभएकाले मृतकहरुको उद्धारमा त समय लाग्नै नै भयो, हत्पत्ति पहिचान खुल्न पनि कठिन छ । ‘सर्लाहीको चक्रघट्टाबाट केही फोन आएको छ, बाँकी कोही सम्पर्कमा आएका छैनन्,’ एसपी खत्रीले भने, ‘अब शव हेटौँडा पुर्याएपछि परिचय खुलाउन लाग्नेछौँ, सम्पर्कमा आउलान् पनि !’

सुरक्षा सावधानी जरुरी

भीमफेदी–कुलेखानी हुँदै काठमाडौँ आवतजावत गर्ने सुमो तथा विद्युतीय सवारीसाधन (इभी)मा यात्रु विवरण राख्ने तथा चलान व्यवस्थापन गर्ने कार्य प्रभावकारी नहुँदा यात्रु सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठेको छ । यो रुटमा सञ्चालन हुने कतिपय सवारीसाधनका चालकले यात्रुको नाम, सम्पर्क नम्बर, यात्रु सङ्ख्या, चढ्ने तथा ओर्लने स्थानसहितको विवरण उल्लेख गरिएको चलान तयार नगरेको पाइएको छ ।

कतिपय अवस्थामा यात्रुलाई टिकट नै नदिने र टिकट दिए पनि यात्रुको नाम तथा सम्पर्क नम्बर उल्लेख नगर्ने समस्या छ । सवारीसाधनमा कति जना यात्रु चढे, को कहाँसम्म जाने हो र कहाँ ओर्लने हो भन्ने विवरणसमेत व्यवस्थित रूपमा अभिलेख नराख्दा यात्रुको वास्तविक अवस्था पत्ता लगाउन कठिन हुने देखिन्छ।

कुनै सवारीसाधन दुर्घटनामा पर्दा कति जना यात्रु सवार थिए, उनीहरू को–को थिए, उनीहरूको सम्पर्क नम्बर के थियो, कहाँबाट चढेका थिए र कहाँ ओर्लने योजना थियो ? यस्ता आधारभूत जानकारी तत्काल उपलब्ध नहुँदा उद्धार, घाइतेको पहिचान तथा परिवारका सदस्यलाई खबर गर्नसमेत कठिनाइ भइरहेको छ ।

Hetauda. Recently, the Hetauda-Bhimphedi-Sisneri and Pakhel road has become better for people from Bara, Parsa, Rautahat, and Sarlahi. People from eastern Chitwan to Parsa Bazaar also use this road to reach Kathmandu. Makawanpur has become a must-see, and people from Indian cities also travel this route. The Bagmati Province government has recently introduced the alternative route, which was put up as a pride project, as a deadly road, saying that even when the Muglin-Malekhu road is blocked, this road must remain operational as a gateway to Kathmandu. Many citizens are losing their lives due to the increase in small vehicle accidents. Even the families of court judges and registrars have been involved in accidents. The same fate is looming for the general public. Despite the short route, the increase in accidents has led to a situation where high-ranking police officers, the army, and even the armed forces have to be deployed in large numbers for rescue operations after accidents. On Thursday morning, 10 people died in an EV accident on the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani Kathmandu road section at Chisapani Gadhi in Bhimphedi-6. It was almost 10 o'clock when 3 people were rescued in the first phase, 2 later and 6 more, including a girl. That is, the vehicle fell 500 meters from the road and faced a steep cliff, which made it difficult, says Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal of the Bhimphedi Area Police Office. He says, 'The first task is to bring the injured up to the road and send them to the hospital, but it is difficult to bring the injured to the road, it may take at least 45 to an hour.' "There are 10 bodies at the scene. It will take about an hour and a half to retrieve them," Dhakal said. "Looking from above, the vehicle fell from a grassy area, but there is a steep cliff below. It is equally challenging to reach the bottom and return to the top." "It is not possible to bring the bodies down from the very steep cliff," said Makawanpur Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, who was at the scene. "We are trying to tie the bodies down and pull them up from the top. Will it take another four hours?" He said that it is not possible to bring the bodies up one by one. 48 security personnel mobilized for rescue Such accidents that have been happening on this road for months have necessitated the mobilization of a large number of security personnel. Even after the news of Thursday's accident, a 48-member team from the army, armed forces, and police was mobilized. The Makawanpur Superintendent of Police himself arrived in the morning with a team of 10. A 7-member team led by Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal had already left for Bhimphedi Area Police Office. Armed Police Force Nepal, which is guarding the Bhimphedi Prison, reached the scene of the incident under the command of DSP Devendra Singh, Armed Police Force of the Nepal Prison Security Base. 11 soldiers were deployed under the command of Arogya Gautam, a soldier from the Multi-Purpose Plastic Industry in Bhimphedi. Assistant Inspector of Police Jay Prakash Yadav from the Bagmati Province Disaster Management Group also reached the scene with a team of 10. 48 security personnel from 3 security agencies were mobilized in one accident. Driver not found. A passenger EV with registration number M.P.03-001 Ja 0880 coming from Kathmandu to Sarlahi fell off a cliff about 500 meters below the road. 10 people died on the spot. 5 men, 3 women and 2 children were found dead. 'It is not yet clear whether the driver is alive or among the dead,' said Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, 'The vehicle does not look like it came from the counter, it looks like it belongs to the reserve, we are looking for the driver.' Since there were no passenger documents in the vehicle, it took time to rescue the deceased, and it is also difficult to identify the deceased. 'We have received some calls from Chakraghatta in Sarlahi, but no one else has been contacted,' said SP Khatri. 'Now, after the bodies are taken to Hetauda, we will start identifying them, they will be contacted!' Safety precautions are essential The inefficiency in maintaining passenger details and managing invoices on Sumo and electric vehicles (EVs) travelling to Kathmandu via Bhimphedi-Kulekhani has raised serious questions about passenger safety. It has been found that some drivers of vehicles operating on this route have not prepared invoices that mention the passenger's name, contact number, number of passengers, and boarding and alighting locations. In some cases, there is a problem of not giving tickets to passengers, and even if tickets are given, the passenger's name and contact number are not mentioned. Without systematic records of how many passengers boarded the vehicle, who was going where, and where they were getting off, it seems difficult to find out the real status of the passengers. Hetauda. Recently, the Hetauda-Bhimphedi-Sisneri and Pakhel road has become better for people from Bara, Parsa, Rautahat, and Sarlahi. People from eastern Chitwan to Parsa Bazaar also use this road to reach Kathmandu.

Makawanpur has become a must-see, and people from Indian cities also travel this route. The Bagmati Province government has recently introduced the alternative route, which was put up as a pride project, as a deadly road, saying that even when the Muglin-Malekhu road is blocked, this road must remain operational as a gateway to Kathmandu.

Many citizens are losing their lives due to the increase in small vehicle accidents. Even the families of court judges and registrars have been involved in accidents. The same fate is looming for the general public.

Despite the short route, the increase in accidents has led to a situation where high-ranking police officers, the army, and even the armed forces have to be deployed in large numbers for rescue operations after accidents.

On Thursday morning, 10 people died in an EV accident on the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani Kathmandu road section at Chisapani Gadhi in Bhimphedi-6. It was almost 10 o'clock when 3 people were rescued in the first phase, 2 later and 6 more, including a girl. That is, the vehicle fell 500 meters from the road and faced a steep cliff, which made it difficult, says Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal of the Bhimphedi Area Police Office. He says, 'The first task is to bring the injured up to the road and send them to the hospital, but it is difficult to bring the injured to the road, it may take at least 45 to an hour.'

"There are 10 bodies at the scene. It will take about an hour and a half to retrieve them," Dhakal said. "Looking from above, the vehicle fell from a grassy area, but there is a steep cliff below. It is equally challenging to reach the bottom and return to the top."

"It is not possible to bring the bodies down from the very steep cliff," said Makawanpur Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, who was at the scene. "We are trying to tie the bodies down and pull them up from the top. Will it take another four hours?" He said that it is not possible to bring the bodies up one by one.

48 security personnel mobilized for rescue

Such accidents that have been happening on this road for months have necessitated the mobilization of a large number of security personnel. Even after the news of Thursday's accident, a 48-member team from the army, armed forces, and police was mobilized. The Makawanpur Superintendent of Police himself arrived in the morning with a team of 10. A 7-member team led by Deputy Inspector of Police Dipendra Dhakal had already left for Bhimphedi Area Police Office.

Armed Police Force Nepal, which is guarding the Bhimphedi Prison, reached the scene of the incident under the command of DSP Devendra Singh, Armed Police Force of the Nepal Prison Security Base. 11 soldiers were deployed under the command of Arogya Gautam, a soldier from the Multi-Purpose Plastic Industry in Bhimphedi. Assistant Inspector of Police Jay Prakash Yadav from the Bagmati Province Disaster Management Group also reached the scene with a team of 10. 48 security personnel from 3 security agencies were mobilized in one accident.

Driver not found.

A passenger EV with registration number M.P.03-001 Ja 0880 coming from Kathmandu to Sarlahi fell off a cliff about 500 meters below the road. 10 people died on the spot. 5 men, 3 women and 2 children were found dead. 'It is not yet clear whether the driver is alive or among the dead,' said Superintendent of Police Shyam Khatri, 'The vehicle does not look like it came from the counter, it looks like it belongs to the reserve, we are looking for the driver.'

Since there were no passenger documents in the vehicle, it took time to rescue the deceased, and it is also difficult to identify the deceased. 'We have received some calls from Chakraghatta in Sarlahi, but no one else has been contacted,' said SP Khatri. 'Now, after the bodies are taken to Hetauda, we will start identifying them, they will be contacted!'
